intro.title: Your space to create
intro.body: Create images and videos, transform existing media and bring your ideas together.
intro.hint: bwdacc controls ComfyUI workflows. Your computer runs the generations.

intro.title: Your computer, connected
intro.body: Set up bwdacc Desktop with a new or existing ComfyUI installation. Then pair this phone.
intro.hint: On the same network, connect locally. Away from home, use your own Tailscale on both devices.

intro.title: One idea. Many possibilities.
intro.body: Write in the prompt pill. Pick a workflow, aspect ratio and up to four results. Add images and Fragments.
intro.hint: Each workflow offers different features. Options depend on the model and installed nodes.

intro.title: Keep what works going
intro.body: Open media to edit, animate, upscale or extend it. Swipe through versions and reuse a generation recipe.
intro.hint: Versions scroll vertically; other sets horizontally. Your selected version becomes the set cover.

intro.title: Keep what matters
intro.body: Experiment in Prompter, save favorites with a double tap and organize your library in Projects.
intro.hint: These guides stay in Settings › App › Tutorials. Revisit them whenever you need.

topics.title: Connect to your computer
topics.summary: Local pairing and access away from home.
steps: In bwdacc Desktop, install a separate ComfyUI or connect an existing installation. Start the server.
On your phone, open Settings › Connection and pair with Desktop. Approve the device on your computer.
Use the same network for local access. Away from home, connect your own Tailscale on both devices and select the private connection in Desktop. Keep the PC on.

topics.title: Create images and videos
topics.summary: Prompts, workflows, aspect ratios and batches.
steps: Tap the compact pill to write. In the Image/Video selector, choose workflow, aspect ratio, resolution and result count where available.
Under + › Images, import up to three images. They join the Gallery and become references when supported. Library uses saved images.
Tap the arrow to generate. Queue and progress appear in the app; time depends on the PC, model and settings. Check the queue in Settings › Connection.

topics.title: Fragments
topics.summary: Your collection of characters, styles and places.
steps: Open Fragments from the top menu. Create characters, styles, locations, objects or compositions; search, edit and duplicate to organize them.
In prompts, use @ for characters, $ for styles, # for locations and & for objects. Choose allowed text, images, refmods and LoRAs for each Fragment.
Images and LoRAs are used only with compatible workflows. Fragment permissions cannot make a model compatible.
Swipe the categories sideways or tap View all. Under Audio, import or record up to 30 seconds with the microphone; save the fragment to use it for lip sync.

topics.title: Composition and maps
topics.summary: Boxes, object selection and control blocks.
steps: On an image, use ⋮ › Extract composition for editable boxes. Select object lets you mark an element and save it as a Fragment. Analysis models must be installed on the server.
In Fragments › Blocks, add depth, pose, lineart or other maps. Import a ready-made map or extract one using preprocessors installed in ComfyUI.
Blocks can be saved and edited, but their maps are not yet applied to generations. Boxes also require a compatible workflow.

topics.title: Edit and reuse
topics.summary: Versions without losing your starting point.
steps: Open media and describe what to change. Image edits stay with images; video edits stay with videos.
Swipe vertically between versions and horizontally between sets. When you leave, the selected version becomes the set cover.
Reuse prompt restores the saved recipe: prompt, references, LoRAs and options. For an edit, it returns to the original reference. Required files and models must remain available.

topics.title: Animate, extend and upscale
steps: Open an image to animate it. The result becomes a new video set. Videos can also start from text alone, depending on the workflow.
In first/last frame mode, add frames to the two named fields. To extend, open ⋮ › Extend video and adjust start/end before submitting.
Use ⋮ › Upscale for images or videos. Editing, extension and upscaling require compatible workflows, nodes, models and memory on the server.

topics.title: Lip sync with MuseTalk
topics.summary: Make an image or video speak to your audio.
steps: Open the media editor and choose ⋮ › Lip sync. Import audio, record with the microphone, or choose an audio Fragment lasting 0.2–30 seconds.
Use one visible, front-facing face. For video, audio must fit the clip and replaces original sound. Images create a new video; videos create a version.
MuseTalk 1.5 must be installed on the connected computer. Generation runs locally. Audio stays in the app vault for recipe reuse and is removed when the result is deleted.

topics.title: LoRAs and agent
steps: Tap the LoRAs pill beside the generation selector. Choose compatible adapters and adjust weights with − and +.
Selected adapters appear first when you reopen the list. Switching workflows may change the available LoRAs.
The star enables the prompt agent in supported workflows. The agent needs its LLM on the server and may change how your text is interpreted.

topics.title: Prompter
topics.summary: Test, refine and save what you like.
steps: Open Prompter from the top menu. Your prompt stays after generation so you can keep refining it.
Double-tap media or use the heart to save it to your collection. It then appears in Feed and Gallery.
Unsaved generations expire from the app after 24 hours. Clearing Prompter removes temporary tests; ComfyUI files remain.

topics.title: Gallery, Feed and Projects
steps: The top menu switches between Feed, Gallery, Prompter, Projects and Fragments. Gallery is your collection; Feed displays your posts.
Create a project, choose a cover and add media from its menu. Rename projects to suit your work.
Deleting from Gallery removes media from every area of the app. Use multi-selection to delete several items. Review the confirmation before deleting.

topics.title: Storage and settings
steps: Media and collection data are encrypted in app storage. Copies on your computer or server have their own protection and retention.
In Settings › App, create a backup and keep its code separately. Without a valid backup and code, losing the key or device may prevent recovery.
Here you can adjust language, autoplay and tilt lighting. Generation settings contain memory profiles and available advanced options. Clear generations deletes the app collection.
